headline: 8 killed and 25 injured in head-on bus collision on Dhaka-Sylhet highway
summary: A catastrophic head-on collision between two passenger buses in Sylhet's Osmaninagar has claimed eight lives and left at least 25 people injured. The accident occurred on the Dhaka-Sylhet highway.
details: Eight people were killed and at least 25 others injured in a head-on collision between two passenger buses in Sylhet's Osmaninagar on Friday morning. The accident took place around 7:30 AM on the Dhaka-Sylhet highway in the Kashikapon area.

The number of casualties was confirmed by the Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Osmaninagar Police Station, Golam Mostafa. He stated that the collision was head-on, and the identities of the deceased and injured are not yet known.

According to police and eyewitnesses, a bus heading towards Sylhet, belonging to Bengal Paribahan, collided with a bus traveling towards Dhaka, operated by Unique Paribahan. The Unique Paribahan bus veered off the road into a ditch following the impact.
At least 25 passengers from both buses sustained injuries. Many of the injured have been rescued and transported to Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital for treatment.

headline_marked: Bus loses control, [[kills 7 labourers]] in Bogra
headline: Bus loses control, kills 7 labourers in Bogra
summary: A tragic accident in Bogra has claimed the lives of seven labourers when a bus veered off course. The incident highlights ongoing road safety concerns in the region.
details: Seven labourers were killed and an unspecified number were injured when a bus lost control and crashed in Bogra. The accident occurred when the vehicle reportedly went off the road.
Emergency services responded to the scene to provide aid and transport the injured to nearby medical facilities. The exact number of injured individuals has not yet been confirmed.
Authorities have launched an investigation into the cause of the accident. Preliminary reports suggest the bus may have been speeding or experienced a mechanical failure.

This incident underscores the persistent issues with road safety in Bangladesh, where frequent accidents result in significant loss of life. Investigations into the driver's actions and the bus's condition are underway.
